versions.changelog:
book-video-generator 2.6.0: Major update with end-to-end book explainer video automation.

- Supports one-click generation of a 3-minute book summary video from book title + author, including review script, scene planning, AI illustrations, TTS audio, subtitles, and MP4 composition.
- Full workflow compatible with WorkBuddy, OpenClaw, Codex CLI, and TRAE Work platforms, with flexible tool mapping for image generation, web search, and TTS.
- Enhanced local open-source toolchain: replaces previous dependencies with platform-agnostic solutions (e.g. ffmpeg, image generation APIs, and TTS engines).
- New support for both Volcano Engine TTS (default, highest quality) and edge-tts (fallback, no API key needed).
- Highly customizable video output: cover generation, progress bar, keyword highlight, and detailed subtitle sync.
- Extensively documented workflow and environment setup in SKILL.md for easy integration and usage.

- No code or documentation changes detected in this release.
- Version number incremented to 2.6.0.
- No user-facing changes. Functionality remains identical to previous version.
